Explicit LIMITED structural revision of revision 6, preserving every accepted requirement and public output. Return the FULL valid TaskPlan; keep all current business operations, IDs, scopes, cell branches, writer inputs/header, cleanup and root outputs. Do not redesign the plan. The only remaining review corrections are these:

1. Replace EXACTLY project_original_product_records (root) and project_original_fact_records (inside visit_products.body) with the following existing typed foreach declarations. They export the ORIGINAL producer record arrays directly. They must not be extract or interpret transforms. No inner record inference, no learned copying, no recreation of record fields. Preserve every record and reference exactly. Existing downstream flatten(field(output(task),port)) remains the correct array-of-arrays use. The declared ports are unchanged, so all consumers can remain unchanged. Replace the full two tasks with these concrete forms (transport may add required null/default keys):

2. In choose_product_ids.resultType, selectedIds has a real array contract minItems:1,maxItems:10,items:string nonnullable. Preserve order and repetitions, no filtering/deduplication. Keep the original lookup against offered candidates followed by original records. has_products never substitutes for that contract.

3. Preserve the success and snapshot-nonnull conjuncts and add ordered captureTruncated == false and manifestTruncated == false assertions to project_home_rows, extract_product_links and project_product_fact_blocks. Use the same concrete completeness predicate shape above with their respective producer. These are actual schema fields, not inferred success flags. Keep short-circuit nonnull before field access.

4. fill_search_query.requires must first keep search_reference != null, then assert strict lookup of [search_reference] against flatten(output(project_home_rows).controlRows) by reference. Browser resolves the exact original observed reference and validates fill compatibility. No optional action.

5. Clarify only the objectives of existing extraction/decision tasks: extract_product_links emits only actual listed product candidates with unchanged identities and complete observed text in page order; project_product_fact_blocks offers only relevant name, price, one complete verbatim description block and actual error evidence. choose_product_fact_ids selects unchanged offered IDs for those facts; description is ONE COMPLETE OBSERVED BLOCK, never summarized/reworded/combined. product_error is null unless actual error evidence exists, copied exactly; ordinary interface controls do not prove errors. This does not authorize any filtering criteria beyond relevance to the accepted facts. Home and search errors likewise require actual observed error evidence, not generated explanations.

Everything else remains exactly as revision 6: all six external operation declarations, writing using structured rows with the existing correct [headerRow,...productRows] binding, deterministic nullable cell projections, accepted root outputs, always cleanup, max 10 visits, permissions and budgets. No new operator, no JS in TaskPlan, no new action, no inference for typed copying or row assembly. The original-record projection MUST use the two concrete foreach replacements above, not mapping.dynamic.
